text:
lexi-fin: Incoming SEPA credit posted this AM for €12,420 from BrightLake. No remittance info and the bank reference is truncated to 'BRIGHTLAKE 12...'. Auto-matcher failed. Can someone pick this up?

billing-bot: Auto-match failed for payment_id 0x8a3f9d. Attempted matches: none. Suggested next step: request MT103 / swift copy from receiving bank.

omar-pay: Noted. Do we have value date, originator BIC or last 4 of IBAN? That helps tracing with correspondent.

lexi-fin: Value date 2024-04-05, originator BIC: BKCHGB2L, beneficiary (our account) IBAN ...1234 (last 4), txn ref from our bank: 987654321. Payer name on bank feed = "BrightLake Ltd" but no PO. Invoice INV-2024-0891 for €12,420 outstanding.

trevor-ops: I'll open a trace with the correspondent. Steps: 1) request MT103 from receiving bank, 2) ask for payer remit note (scanner) and full payment narrative, 3) check PSP portal for any attached customer docs. Use our trace template.

lexi-fin: Can you paste the /create-wire-trace command you use? I'll attach to the ticket.

trevor-ops: Sure — run locally:```
/create-wire-trace --payment 0x8a3f9d --bank-ref 987654321 --amount 12420 --currency EUR --contact receiving-bank@psp.com
```
Then include: originator name, full BIC, value date, beneficiary IBAN last 4.

sasha-cs: I just emailed BrightLake PM (julia@brightlake.com) asking for the PO number and a screenshot of their payment instruction. I included our ticket link.

omar-pay: If bank can't provide MT103 quickly, we can request a recall with corres bank — that adds time. Also confirm VAT treatment: invoice shows VAT-exempt reverse charge, confirm buyer details match.

lexi-fin: Good call, Omar. I've put a temporary block on auto-apply for any similar partial refs to avoid misallocations (small rule change).

billing-bot: Bank reply required by 2024-04-07 17:00 UTC for initial trace acceptance. Ticket #WI-2024-145 created.

trevor-ops: Update from bank: receiving bank asks for original beneficiary's payment narrative — they only provide truncated text 'BRIGHTLAKE 12'. They've escalated to payments ops and asked for our MT103 request form attached to ticket. I uploaded our trace template.

sasha-cs: Customer replied with payment screenshot: shows reference "BrightLake Invoice 0891 PO 5532" but the sending corporate bank stripped the PO on transmission. Screenshot link: https://files.internal/brightlake-pay-2024-04-05.png

omar-pay: Perfect — Sasha, can you confirm exact PO and the payer legal name match X. If yes, we can manually allocate to INV-2024-0891 and close the ticket after attaching docs.

lexi-fin: I manually applied the amount to INV-2024-0891 after verifying screenshot and IBAN last4. Notes added: "manual allocation after customer-provided remittance screenshot; awaiting SWIFT copy for audit." Marking as pending SWIFT copy.

billing-bot: Allocation done by lexi-fin, internal ref: alloc_20240405_1723. Ticket WI-2024-145 remains open until MT103 is received.

trevor-ops: Bank returned MT103 (SWIFT copy) — includes full sender narrative with PO 5532 and originator acct. Uploading to ticket and closing trace.

lexi-fin: Confirmed MT103 matches screenshot and allocation. Closing thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
